note: When upgrading from `v1.0` to `v1.1`, no special upgrade steps are required 🎉.
reason: the vendor states there is no breaking change in this release. A rule here could only ever CLEAR, which is noise in the ledger.

note: In an effort to introduce new features whilst keeping the project maintainable,…
reason: a Kubernetes VERSION FLOOR (1.2 needs k8s 1.16+) plus the CRD replace steps that follow from it. The catalog's own support matrix already carries that window and the add-on tier evaluates it as a hop, so a rule here would report the same fact through a second engine.

note: Removal of the cert-manager operator package on Red Hat Marketplace
reason: an OLM PACKAGING change: the Red Hat Marketplace operator package is replaced by the Community Operators one. Nothing about it is a Kubernetes object this product collects, and the re-install is done through OLM, not through cert-manager.

note: If running Kubernetes versions before `v1.22`, the `ServerSideApply` feature gate _must_…
reason: conditional on Kubernetes older than 1.22, which is below the floor of every version in the catalog's support matrix (cert-manager 1.9 itself starts at k8s 1.20, and no supported cert-manager release runs on a cluster this rule could fire on).

note: There are no breaking changes between cert-manager `v1.10` and `v1.11` unless you're…
reason: the guide's own lead-in to the Gateway API note that follows it; that note carries the rule (rtz-cert-manager-1.11-gateway-api-crds-move-to-v1beta1).

note: There are no breaking changes between cert-manager 1.11 and 1.12.
reason: the vendor states there is no breaking change in this release.

note: cert-manager v1.12 is a Long Term Support (LTS) release sponsored by Venafi, a CyberArk…
reason: the LTS guide's own table of contents — it says what the three sections of the document are, not what changed.

note: Upgrading from v1.12 to v1.17
reason: the LTS SKIP-PATH summary. Every item in it restates a change already filed under the minor that introduced it — the startupapicheck image (1.14/1.15), Helm schema validation (1.16), the webhook featureGates split and CertificateRequest KeyUsages validation (1.13), the Gateway API flag (1.15), the Venafi issuer changes (1.16) and the RSA signature algorithms (1.17) — and each of those notes carries its own rule. A rule here would report the same findings a second time, on a version where they did not happen.

note: Log messages across cert-manager have been augmented with better contextual structured…
reason: a LOG FORMAT change. What it can break is log-based alerting that matches literal strings, which lives in a log pipeline outside the cluster — no Kubernetes object carries it.

note: As Kubernetes `v1.16` is now the earliest supported version, The `legacy` manifests have…
reason: the same Kubernetes VERSION FLOOR the guide's 1.2 note carries (excluded above): the catalog's support matrix already evaluates it as a hop.

note: The `User-Agent` request header has been changed from `jetstack-cert-manager/<version>`…
reason: an HTTP User-Agent string. What it can break is an allowlist in a corporate proxy, which is outside the cluster — no Kubernetes object carries it.

note: `.exe` Extension on Windows
reason: a change to the Windows build of the `cmctl` CLI binary on an operator's workstation; nothing in the cluster changes.

note: Changed Import Path
reason: a Go module import path for people who compile against cert-manager's source; nothing in the cluster changes.

note: Potentially Breaking: Gateway API Upgrade
reason: the release notes' POINTER at the 1.11 upgrade guide, whose Gateway API note carries the rule (rtz-cert-manager-1.11-gateway-api-crds-move-to-v1beta1).

note: Potentially Breaking: Challenge and Order RBAC restricted in `cert-manager-edit` ClusterRole
reason: covered by `rtz-cert-manager-1.21-cert-manager-edit-loses-challenge-order-create`, whose introducedIn ["1.19.6", "1.20.3", "1.21.0"] carries this line's patch — one rule per change, so a hop from any line selects it once (a second copy here would fire beside it on every hop that crosses both, and without its patch it was selected for a hop that ends below the patch and missed for a patch-only hop onto it).

note: Breaking change: pprof now runs by default on `localhost:6060` on the webhook and the…
reason: profiling stays OFF unless `--enable-profiling` is set (options.go at v1.7.0); what changed is the default ADDRESS an operator who turns it on gets. Nothing about a running install changes on upgrade.

note: POTENTIALLY BREAKING: the cert-manager binaries and some tests have been split into…
reason: a Go MODULE layout change: the vendor's own text says it has no impact on running cert-manager in a cluster, only on code that imports its binaries or tests.

note: Cainjector memory improvements: removes second cache of secrets, CRDs,…
reason: breaks only a cainjector run WITHOUT the `certificates.cert-manager.io` CRD; every cert-manager install (Helm, manifests, OLM) ships that CRD, so the condition cannot hold on a cluster where this add-on is detected.

note: Startupapicheck image change
reason: restates 1.14: the chart switched startupapicheck from the cert-manager-ctl image to its own image in v1.14.0 (values.yaml:1223; v1.13.0:687 still names cert-manager-ctl). Carried by rtz-cert-manager-1.14-startupapicheck-image-changed.
